concept.title: The Date That Missed Its Reservation
concept.human_truth: Mature love does not remove childish irritation; it learns the feeling beneath it and still finds a way back to play.
concept.emotional_arc: playful departure -> small irritation -> respectful pause -> disappointment understood -> accidental roadside date -> affectionate callback

slides.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.
slides.visual: Rain-damp evening beside a tiny roadside chai stall. Exactly Aachu and Zuv stand under one umbrella beside their modest dark car, safely parked on the quieter service lane away from traffic, dressed for a proper date. Across the divided road, through moving cars, the intended restaurant on the next road is visibly close but inconvenient to reach. The chai stall glows immediately beside them. Aachu points toward the chai stall with her right hand while her left hand stays relaxed and visible. Zuv holds the umbrella in his right hand and lowers the phone map in his left; they exchange a small conspiratorial 'shall we?' look. This is the decision before the accidental date, not the seated payoff. No chai vendor or background people visible.
slides.emotion: rainy frustration turning into a shared mischievous decision
slides.props: one umbrella, one modest dark parked car, lowered phone map, glowing chai stall, distant restaurant frontage across divided road
slides.continuity_lock: Same date-night wardrobe, same modest dark car, same umbrella, and same rainy evening continue through slides 2-7. Exactly two visible people in every frame. No scooter or helmets.

slides.copy:
The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.
slides.visual: Inside their entryway before leaving, Aachu holds a soft tote by its strap and points a playful accusing finger while Zuv checks his jacket pockets and looks theatrically innocent. The missing car key is visibly caught in the tote strap between them. Exactly two people; the physical evidence makes the joke readable without text.
slides.props: car key, tote bag, closed umbrella near the door
slides.continuity_lock: Same date-night wardrobe, car key, tote, and umbrella used throughout the outing. No scooter or helmets.

slides.copy:
By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.
slides.visual: They stand beside their modest dark car, safely parked on the quieter service lane of a rain-slick divided road. A phone map in Zuv's hand reroutes while the intended restaurant is frustratingly visible across the traffic on the next road. Aachu holds the closed umbrella downward and looks away toward the restaurant, tired and irritated; Zuv studies the route with restrained frustration. Exactly two visible people and no human reflections.
slides.emotion: comic frustration tipping into real irritation
slides.props: parked dark car, closed umbrella, phone map without legible UI text, traffic divider, distant restaurant frontage
slides.continuity_lock: Same car, route, wardrobe, umbrella, weather, and evening. The parked car must remain separate from moving traffic.

slides.copy:
“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.
slides.visual: At a safe recessed roadside edge near their parked dark car, Aachu faces slightly away with arms folded. Zuv stays beside the car several feet behind her, body open and grounded, not reaching or crowding. His phone hangs lowered at his side; the closed umbrella leans securely against the car. The empty space between them communicates a respected pause while his remaining nearby communicates care. Exactly two people.
slides.props: parked dark car, lowered phone, closed umbrella
slides.continuity_lock: Same road, weather, wardrobe, car, phone, and umbrella.

slides.copy:
It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.
slides.visual: Across the road outside the intended restaurant, the frontage is closed or inaccessible after the long detour. Aachu's irritation has fallen into quiet disappointment as she looks at the dark entrance. Zuv notices her expression rather than the shutter, holding the phone down at his side. Their body distance has narrowed but they do not yet touch. Exactly two people, no background diners or staff.
slides.props: restaurant frontage across the divided road, phone held down, partial parked car, rain traces
slides.continuity_lock: Same evening, wardrobe, car route, and date.

slides.copy:
The plan failed.
The date didn’t.
slides.visual: At the tiny roadside chai stall beside their safely parked dark car, Aachu steals a sip from Zuv's chai after finishing hers. The glass is visibly at her own lips, not being offered to him. Zuv gives her a mock-offended look while protecting the biscuit packet against his chest. Two stools are now pulled close. The unreachable restaurant glows softly across the divided road behind traffic. Exactly two people, vendor out of frame.
slides.props: two chai glasses, biscuit packet, two close stools, parked dark car, distant restaurant
slides.continuity_lock: Exact return to the cover location and same wardrobe.

slides.copy:
He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.
slides.visual: Callback to the moment they left for the date, viewed entirely from OUTSIDE the apartment in the corridor after the front door has closed. Zuv stands at the fully closed exterior door and tests the exterior handle with his right hand while holding the car key in his left. Aachu had already taken two steps toward the lift, rolled her eyes, then visibly turned and came back; her returning body direction and trailing foot make the turn-back path readable. She now joins him and tests the same closed handle with her right hand while her left holds the closed umbrella. Their shared amused look says she has the same habit she teases him for. Exactly two people. This is before departure, outside the closed door, and both participate in the lock check; never show them inside the house, after returning from the date, or with only Aachu checking while Zuv watches.
slides.props: fully closed apartment door viewed from corridor, exterior handle, car key in Zuv's free hand, closed umbrella in Aachu's free hand, lift direction implied without readable signage
slides.continuity_lock: Same date-night wardrobe, car key, and umbrella as the departure setup. Nonlinear callback to before the date: camera outside the apartment; door fully closed; Aachu visibly returns from the lift direction; both check together. No interior view, key bowl, helmets, or post-date arrival.

copy.caption_recommended: May we grow into the kind of love that gives each other a minute, not a distance—and still knows when the proper date can become two glasses of roadside chai.
copy.caption_alt: The plan failed. The date didn’t.
